content: In this paper, we present knowledge based machine reading comprehension, which requires reasoning over triplet-style knowledge involved in a document. However, we find published dataset do not sufficiently support this task. We conduct preliminary exploration on SQuAD BIBREF0 . We use a strong open IE algorithm BIBREF9 to extract triplets from the documents and observe that only 15% of instances have an answer that is exactly the same as the corresponding subject/object in the extracted triplets. To do knowledge-based MRC, We build a new dataset consisting of 40,047 examples for the knowledge based MRC task. The annotation of this dataset is designed so that successfully answering the questions requires understanding and the knowledge involved in a document. Each instance is composed of a question, a set of triplets derived from a document, and the answer.
